identity: host authenticated company and registered instance; never browser supplied tenant_id
layout: one registered Agent item with compact entry/expanded inbox workspace states in one native host card; preserve selection and per-conversation drafts across views

responsive_layout.default: list and conversation with context drawer
responsive_layout.narrow: list or selected detail with back navigation and context drawer

prohibited_host_writes: overview content or cards other than this Agent
security: no remote HTML, script or iframe
mount only the Agent root and its namespaced routes
CAS on settings, knowledge and tasks
data_scope: one instance per company; external SQLite requires its own backup coverage

requirements: pending suggestions cannot change active knowledge
readback of approval and rejected/stale states
procedure guidance cannot prove business facts

required_verification: 320 CSS px list/detail and context drawer
default read-only self tests and explicit self-reply grants remain separate from customer automation, learning and counts
namespaced knowledge-learning routes and owner review
